# rok-ui

> shadcn/ui-style components and an app framework for GPUI desktop apps (Rust). React-like
> components, TanStack-style data, routing and forms. Docs: https://docs.rs/rok-ui. Guides:
> docs/guide/*.md (also the module docs). Plan: enhance.md. Progress: roadmap.md.

## Setup

- Cargo: `rok-ui = "0.5"` plus `gpui = "0.2.2"`. Every component is a feature; `full` (default)
  enables all components, `state` and `form`. Opt-in: `router`, `query`, `db` (implies
  `query`), `runtime`, `persist`, `devtools`, `form-garde`, `fonts`.
- New app: `cargo install rok-ui-cli`, then `cargo rok-ui new my-app --template full`
  (`minimal` | `full` | `db`); `cargo rok-ui add button` copies a component's source into
  `src/components/ui/`.
- Startup: `Application::new().with_assets(rok_ui::Assets).run(|cx| { rok_ui::init(cx); .. })`.
  Wrap window content in `AppRoot::new()`.
- `use rok_ui::prelude::*;` brings GPUI's prelude, every component, `Cx`, hooks and macros.

## Conventions (every API follows these)

- Hooks take the context first, then an options value: `use_query(cx, note_query(id))`,
  `use_form(cx, sign_up_form())`, `use_mutation(cx, options)`, `use_procedure(cx, proc)`.
- Options are builders with documented defaults, built by plain functions so loaders,
  components and tests share them.
- State is read through typed objects: `QueryResult::state() -> QueryState::{Pending, Error,
  Success}`, `FieldApi::meta()`, `Form::state()`.
- Builders take `mut self`, return `Self` and are `#[must_use]`. Controlled props use
  `value`/`on_change`, `open`/`on_open_change`, `checked`, `selected_index`.
- Every imperative API has a function form for code outside components: `router::navigate`,
  `query::fetch_query`, `form.set_value`.
- Background work (queries, mutations, procedures) runs on `rok_ui::runtime` (tokio) and reads
  values registered with `query::provide(cx, value)` through `TaskCx::get::<T>()`.

## Components

- `#[component] fn Name(prop: T, #[default] opt: U, #[default(px(32.))] size: Pixels,
  #[children] children: Vec<AnyElement>, #[sx] sx: Sx, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl IntoElement`
  generates `Name::new(prop).opt(..).size(..).child(..)` (`#[prop(optional)]` = `#[default]`).
  Parameters named `window`/`cx` receive GPUI's `&mut Window`/`&mut App`, or `cx: &mut Cx`
  (both in one handle; derefs to `App`, `cx.window` is the window).
- Hooks: `use_state(window, cx, init)`, `cx.use_state(init)`, `use_keyed_state(key, ..)`,
  `use_signal`, `use_tracked`, `use_input_state(key, window, cx, configure)`.
- Styling: `styles! { NAME = { key: { prop: value, hover: {..} }, variant(Enum): {..} } }`,
  `style! { .. }`, `.sx((&NAME.key, cond.then_some(&NAME.other), &sx))`. Theme tokens:
  `primary`, `muted_foreground`, `border`, `ring`; lengths are 4px units (`gap: 6` = 24px).
- Markup: `view! { Card(sx = ..) { CardTitle("Hi") if x { .. } for i in xs { .. } } }`,
  `children![a, if c { b } else { d }, for x in xs => e(x)]`. `#[key(item.id)] for item in items`
  keeps hook state with reordered items (`Keyed::new(&key, child)` by hand).
- State: `#[derive(Store)] struct Todo { title: String }` gives `TodoStore` with a signal per
  field (`todo.title()`, `set_title`, `update_title`, `get`, `set`). `persist::persisted_store(cx,
  "settings", Settings::default)` saves a store as versioned JSON (feature `persist`).
- Devtools (feature `devtools`): add `devtools::Devtools::new()` to the root; Ctrl-Shift-D.
- RTL: `set_text_direction(TextDirection::Rtl, cx)`, `Direction::new(..)`, logical props
  (`padding_start`), `BidiText` for text.

## Data: rok_ui::query (feature `query`)

- `QueryOptions::new(query_key!["notes", id], |cx: TaskCx| async move { Ok::<_, E>(..) })`
  `.stale_time(d) .gc_time(d) .retry(n) .enabled(b) .initial_data(v) .placeholder_data(v)
  .keep_previous_data(true) .refetch_interval(d) .refetch_on_window_focus(true)`.
- `query::use_query(cx, opts) -> QueryResult<T>` (`state()`, `data()`, `error()`,
  `is_fetching()`, `is_stale()`); `use_suspense_query(cx, opts)?` inside
  `Suspense::new(|cx| Ok(..)).fallback(..).error(|e, cx| ..)`; `ErrorBoundary::new(content, fallback)`.
- Keys are hierarchical: `query::invalidate(cx, &query_key!["notes"])` invalidates every key
  under `notes`. Also `fetch_query`, `ensure_query_data`, `prefetch_query`, `set_query_data`,
  `update_query_data`, `get_query_data`, `cancel_queries`, `reset_queries`, `queries(cx)`.
- Mutations: `use_mutation(cx, MutationOptions::new(|cx, input| async ..).invalidates(key)
  .on_success(|out, input, cx| ..).optimistic(|input, cache| cache.update(&key, |v: &mut T| ..)))`;
  `m.mutate(cx, input)`, `m.mutate_handler(input)`, `m.is_pending()`, `m.data()`, `m.error()`.
- Procedures: `#[procedure(invalidates = [query_key!["notes"]])] async fn create_note(cx: TaskCx,
  input: NewNote) -> Result<Note, NoteError> { .. }` then `use_procedure(cx, create_note)` or
  `create_note.call(cx, input)`.
- `#[memoize] async fn f(arg: A) -> T` shares one in-flight future per argument;
  `query::memo::invalidate(prefix)`.
- Database (feature `db`): `db::connect(url, cx)`, `db::db_query(key, |db| async ..)`,
  `db::db_mutation(|db, input| async ..)`, `db::run(cx, |db| async ..)`.

## Routing: rok_ui::router (feature `router`)

- Code-based: `Router::new().route("/notes/:id", |route, window, cx| ..).redirect(from, to)
  .not_found(..).guard("/admin", |location, cx| Ok(()) or Err(RouteControl::redirect(path)))
  .loader("/notes/:id", |route, cx| ..)`.
- Typed: `typed_route! { pub struct NoteRoute = "/notes/:id" { pub id: u64 } }` (checked at
  compile time); `Link::to(&NoteRoute { id })`, `router::navigate_to(&route, cx)`,
  `router::use_params::<NoteRoute>(cx)`, `.route_to(|note: NoteRoute, w, cx| ..)`,
  `.loader_to(|note: &NoteRoute, cx| ..)`, `Link::preload(true)`.
- Search params: `#[derive(Search)] struct S { #[search(default = 1)] page: u32, q: Option<String> }`;
  `router::use_search::<S>(cx)`, `router::update_search::<S>(cx, |s| ..)`, `Link::search(&s)`.
- `router::use_blocker(cx, dirty)` holds navigation; `blocker.proceed(cx)` / `reset(cx)`.
- `router::set_per_window_history(true, cx)` gives each window its own history;
  `router::with_window(handle, || ..)`; `router::persist_location("main", cx)` (with `persist`).
- File-based: `rok-ui-build` in build-dependencies, `rok_ui_build::routes("src/routes").generate()`
  in build.rs, `rok_ui::routes!();` in the crate, `routes::tree()` renders. Files: `__root.rs`,
  `__not_found.rs`, `index.rs`, `$id.rs`, `$.rs`, `a.b.rs`, `_pathless.rs`, `(group)/`,
  `-ignored/`, `[escaped].rs`. Each file: `file_route! { params: { id: u64 }, search: S,
  component: Page | layout: Layout, before_load: |loc, cx| .., loader: |route, cx| .. }`; in the
  file, `Route` is its generated type and `params(cx)` / `search(cx)` read it.

## Forms: rok_ui::form (feature `form`)

- `#[derive(FormValues)] struct SignUp { email: String, team: Vec<Invite> }` adds
  `SignUp::EMAIL: Field<SignUp, String>`; paths compose: `SignUp::TEAM.at(0).then(Invite::EMAIL)`.
- `FormOptions::new(defaults).field(SignUp::EMAIL, Validators::new().on_change(..).on_blur(..)
  .on_change_async_debounce(d, |v| async ..).listen_to(&SignUp::PASSWORD))
  .validators(FormValidators::new().on_submit(|v| Some(FormError::field(&SignUp::CONFIRM, ".."))))
  .on_submit(|values, cx| Task<Result<(), FormError>>)`.
- `let form = form::use_form(cx, opts); let email = form.field(cx, SignUp::EMAIL);`
  `TextField::new(&email, "Email")`, `CheckboxField`, `SwitchField`, `BoundInput`,
  `SubmitButton::new(&form, "Save")`, `FormErrors::new(&form)`.
- `form.array_field(cx, SignUp::TEAM)`: `push_value`, `remove_value`, `swap_values`,
  `move_value`, `insert_value`, `replace_value`, `push_handler`, `remove_handler`.
- Errors are kept per `ValidationEvent` (`Mount`, `Change`, `Blur`, `Submit`, `Server`).
  `GardeSchema` (feature `form-garde`) validates with `garde::Validate`.

## Repository rules

- Crates: `rok-ui`, `rok-ui-macros` (entry points), `rok-ui-grammar` (macro parsing and codegen,
  tested in `rok-ui-grammar/tests`), `rok-ui-build` (route generator), `rok-ui-cli`.
- No `mod.rs`; barrel files. Every doc example compiles (no `ignore`). Clippy pedantic + `missing_docs` must be clean
  (`RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features`).
- Tests describe behavior; UI tests use `#[gpui::test]`. Macro errors are trybuild cases.
- Conventional Commits with scopes (`feat(router): ..`). See AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/.
